notes: City of Fort Worth, TX: the whole city within city limits, across Tarrant, Denton, Parker, Wise and Johnson Counties. Built by data/jurisidictions/run_fortworth.py on the shared Tarrant builder (tad_city.py). 302,411 parcels, $30.56B land (Tarrant $28.19B, Denton $1.99B, Parker $359M). All values 2026 (asserted per county).

Sources: the City of Fort Worth's public parcel layer (Parcels_Public_Vview; Tarrant rows are TAD's roll refreshed nightly, Denton/Parker/Wise/Johnson rows loaded from those appraisal districts). 12,625 Tarrant accounts the layer carries without a land/improvement split (mostly builder lots in new subdivisions plus much of downtown) are filled from TAD's own 2026 PropertyData export.
City limits: Census TIGER/Line 2025 place 4827000 (boundaries as of 2025-01-01; the city's hosted copy is TIGER 2024, 6.3 km2 smaller). Taxing-unit codes agree on all but 523 / 432 of ~322k accounts.

Exempt land dropped: $0 City of Fort Worth taxable value on appraised non-residential parcels, plus class X and named public owners (7,679 records). Homes with $0 taxable (10,389, mostly 100% disabled-veteran homesteads) stay in as private land. SPTB class O (residential inventory: builder lots, 9.2k) is real land and kept.

Agricultural tracts recorded with $0 land use market minus improvements (1,509). 26 possessory-interest leaseholds on public land are left off. 20 Parker/Wise/Johnson tracts the source layer draws only partly have land and improvement value prorated by the drawn share. Denton parcels take acreage from their legal descriptions where stated.

Stacked records summed onto their footprint (3,317 footprints, 10,266 records). Condo developments merged onto their land (1,634 units, 66 developments: 48 onto their own Texas Tax Code §23.18 common-area parcel, 18 onto the unit hull grown into unparcelled ground). 4 footprint-lot townhome developments treated the same way. 2,511 leftover nominal common areas (3,840 ac) dropped like exempt land.

Singularity sweep (land $/sqft >= 4x the 300 m neighbourhood and in the city's top 10%): 263 of 302,411 parcels, all genuine appraiser values or hidden slivers; nothing unresolved. Review list: fortworth-tx-singularities.csv.

Parking is OSM delivered through Overture Maps (release 2026-10-21.0, --overture-only), classified surface vs structure: 981 lots, 1,290 acres, $619M est. land value. apply_parking_category.py tagged 192 parcels 'Parking Lot'.
Links: Tarrant parcels open TAD's property page by account (verified). Denton and Parker parcels link to that district's property search (per-parcel URL patterns not verified).
